applicability: Historical: the _is_dir sort key of the list walk. Current: _folder_entries/_folder_row of the folder endpoint.
conditions: The entry's stat raises OSError of any errno: the row is skipped, never listed.
exclusions: Errors outside ENOENT, ENOTDIR, EBADF and ELOOP, which propagate as they did through Path.is_dir().
Per-entry stat errors of any errno, which are skipped rather than propagated (partial continuity: skip-behavior holds, propagate-clause retired).
statement: Dated L55 bound for the superseded walk: the directory-first sort key treated ENOENT, ENOTDIR, EBADF and ELOOP from a followed stat as not-a-directory and propagated every other error. Current folder endpoint: _folder_entries sorts directories first, case-folded, exact name breaking ties; per-entry stat failures of any errno are skipped by _folder_row and never fail the answer — the propagate-other-errors promise does not carry to per-entry stats; errors from opening or listing the folder itself propagate.
